newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 12.1 PCT IN JAN-APRIL.
newsitem.headline: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 12.1 PCT IN JAN-APRIL.

text.p: Estonia's industrial sales rose by 12.1 percent during the first four months of 1997 compared to a rise of 0.3 percent in the same period in 1996, the country's statistics office said on Wednesday.
Industrial sales were approximately 9.9 billion kroons in the first four months of the year, it added in a statement.
Manufacturing sales increased 16.9 percent in the period.

The increase in wood manufacturing was 55.7 percent, construction material manufacturing 39 percent, rubber and plastic products manufacturing 31.3 percent, paper manufacturing 18.3 percent and in furniture production 20.8 percent.
The growth was lower than average in food products, textiles, leather and footwear and chemistry products.
Electricity production was up 23.9 percent and heating 4.5 percent.
